verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex is a SaaS payroll/HR platform, so an official MCP server is a plausible offering and the axis applies. The evidence shows only a REST API with OAuth 2.0 and webhooks, plus in-product AI features. Neither counts as an MCP server. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs also returned 404, and nothing in the pack mentions MCP.
